risk_summary.quantity_basis: gross held positions; pending orders not netted

positions.thesis: AeroVironment is a defense-autonomy and unmanned-systems backlog-conversion position. BlueHalo integration, funded orders, and supply-chain execution must turn fiscal 2026's acquisition-led scale into durable organic growth, margins, and cash flow.
A development-stage bet on Project Matador becoming a scarce, gigawatt-scale powered AI campus. Commercial agreements and funded delivery—not headline capacity—must validate it.

Paychex is a payroll and human-capital-management compounder with Paycor integration upside. Fiscal 2027 organic growth, cross-selling, and margin expansion must outrun acquisition amortization, debt costs, labor-market softness, and an expensive recurring-revenue multiple.

DoorDash is a local-commerce network position. Order and GOV growth, DashPass engagement, Deliveroo integration, and grocery/retail unit economics must compound faster than insurance, regulation, autonomy investment, and international complexity consume the margin upside.

Live Nation is a live-events demand and venue-capacity position. Record ticket sales and deferred revenue must convert into double-digit adjusted operating income and cash flow while legal remedies, capital intensity, weather, and artist or fan affordability do not impair the flywheel.
